'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] says that it attacked two [[oil refinery|oil refineries]] and an [[airfield]] in [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]], using [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/04/27/ukraine-says-hit-two-russian-oil-refineries-in-drone-attack-defense-source (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-drones-target-two-refineries-airfield-russias-krasnodar-region-kyiv-2024-04-27/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missiles strike Ukrainian power plants and natural gas storage facilities in [[Lviv Oblast|Lviv]], [[Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast|Ivano-Frankivsk]], and [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-hits-ukrainian-energy-facilities-three-regions-kyiv-says-2024-04-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-says-russia-targeted-gas-facilities-that-secure-eu-supply-2024-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[humanitarian aid]] [[flotilla]] headed for [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] was halted in [[Turkey]] after [[Guinea-Bissau]] withdrew its flag from two out of three vessels. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-aid-flotilla-halted-after-vessels-flag-removed-activists-say-2024-04-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornadoes of 2024]]
**[[Tornado outbreak sequence of April 25–28, 2024]]
***At least three fatalities are reported in [[Oklahoma]] as a tornado outbreak impacts the central [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/28/weather/plains-midwest-storms-tornadoes-climate-sunday/index.html (CNN)][https://apnews.com/article/tornadoes-storms-oklahoma-damage-3106c502a148f7ea969809cbd3b2d6ba (AP)]
**At least five people are killed and at least 33 others are injured by a tornado in [[Guangzhou]], [[China]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/27/china/tornado-guangzhou-china-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]]-6.5 [[earthquake]] strikes off the southwestern coast of [[Java]] island, [[Indonesia]]. The [[epicenter]] of the earthquake was located about 150 kilometers away from [[Garut]], [[West Java]]. At least four people are injured and some buildings are damaged. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/04/28/magnitude-65-earthquake-strikes-off-java-island-authorities.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
*A munitions truck explodes at a [[Royal Cambodian Armed Forces|military]] base in [[Kampong Speu province]], [[Cambodia]], killing 20 soldiers and destroying multiple buildings. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2024/4/27/twenty-cambodian-soldiers-killed-in-ammunition-base-explosion-pm (Al Jazeera)] [https://amp.dw.com/en/cambodia-20-soldiers-killed-in-army-base-blast/a-68938911 (DW)]

'''Law and crime''' 
* At least one person is killed in a stab attack in [[Koszalin]]'s Rokosowo district, [[Poland]]. Łukasz R. was charged and arrested on April 29. [https://koszalininfo.pl/tragiczny-pozar-na-rokosowie-jedna-osoba-nie-zyje-foto-film/ (KoszalinInfo)]
*[[Crocus City Hall attack]]
**Authorities in [[Russia]] arrest a fifth suspect in last month's attack on a music venue in [[Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast]], [[Russia]], a [[Tajikistan|Tajik]] man accused of providing the attackers with financing and communication. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-shooting-suspect-arrested-2f52dc4bb74337d32cd6fa176f30e15c (AP)]
*[[LGBT rights in Iraq]]
**[[Iraq]]'s [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|parliament]] votes to criminalize [[same-sex relationship]]s, to be punishable by a maximum of 15 years in prison. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraq-criminalises-same-sex-relationships-with-maximum-15-years-prison-2024-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*Three police officers are killed during an [[ambush]] in [[Cañete, Chile|Cañete]], [[Chile]], after receiving false emergency calls. They are [[Mass shooting|shot dead]] before their vehicle is [[Arson|set on fire]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/chiles-president-boric-declares-national-mourning-period-after-3-police-officers-2024-04-27/ (Reuters)]
